facts.text: The DS1102 connects over USB in PC mode with VID 0x5345 and PID 0x1234; USBTMC mode (PID 1235) is not supported
The physical layer is USB bulk transfer with OUT endpoint 0x01 and IN endpoint 0x81
Every command is prefixed with a 4-byte little-endian length header and ends with a line feed
Replies are read from the IN endpoint with dev.read
Metadata is fetched with :DATA:WAVE:SCREEN:HEAD? and parsed as the JSON between the first '{' and the last '}'
get_measurements reads FREQUENCE, SCALE, COUPLING, DISPLAY and OFFSET from each CHANNEL entry
The firmware OFFSET is an integer raw value from the metadata JSON, not volts
The device transfers 1520 samples per channel (3040 bytes plus a 4-byte header) in SCREEN mode
The vertical scale command is :CH<channel>:SCALe <scale>
The horizontal scale command is :HORizontal:SCALe <scale>
The coupling command is :CH<channel>:COUPling <coupling> and the tool accepts AC, DC and GND
The offset command is :CH<channel>:OFFSet <offset> written with three decimals
The trigger mode is written with :TRIGger:SWEep and accepts AUTO, NORMAL and SINGLE
The trigger slope is written with :TRIGger:EDGE:SLOpe and accepts RISE and FALL
The trigger source is written with :TRIGger:EDGE:SOURce and accepts CH1 and CH2
The trigger level is written with :TRIGger:EDGE:LEVel in mV with one decimal
Autoset sends :AUToset on
The run state is written with :run or :stop
The firmware always reports TRIG in the status field, even when stopped
The command throttle is 0.05 s
send_cmd sleeps 0.1 s after SCAL, HOR, TRIG or OFFS and 1.0 s after AUT

operator_required.name: channel1_scale
operator_required.reason: the clone gives the examples '1V' and '500mV' (README.md:30) but no complete allowed set; the site supplies the scale spellings its probe and scope accept

operator_required.name: channel1_offset_v
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states a vertical offset range; it depends on the scale and the probe, so the site supplies the window of its unit

operator_required.name: horizontal_scale
operator_required.reason: the clone gives the examples '1ms' and '500us' (README.md:33) but no complete allowed set; the site supplies the timebase spellings its unit accepts

operator_required.name: trigger_level_mv
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states a trigger level range; it depends on the trigger source and the scale, so the site supplies the window of its unit

safe_state.description: acquisition stopped (:stop); the scope captures nothing until an operator starts it again
